title: 第23章 投鼠忌器第24章 反派死于话多
lines: 在重归寂静的深海，波塞冬独自伫立。
他的目光仿佛穿透了无尽的海水与混乱的战场，遥遥锁定了某个方向。
在那里，原始海神蓬托斯，正以与他相似的姿态，俯瞰着这片因他而沸腾的杀戮场。
在波塞冬的感知中，蓬托斯那古老而庞大的神躯上，正缠绕着浓稠如实质的墨绿色幽光。
那幽光仿佛拥有生命，如同无数邪恶的触须般链接着战场上每一个追随他的海洋生灵。
而那些生灵，无论是强大的海怪，还是美丽的仙女，眼中都闪烁着同款失去自我意识的光芒。
蓬托斯那副模样，在波塞冬看来，简直就像前世某些幻想作品中那些堕落腐朽，以操控灵魂为乐的邪神一样！
“真是的......成了神之后，这日子过得可比前世刺激多了。”
波塞冬不知是感叹还是在自嘲地低语了一句。
随即，他眼神一凛，所有慵懒与随意瞬间收敛。
他反手凝聚出海神三叉戟，同时轻轻吹了声口哨。
希律律——！
一声嘹亮如龙吟，又带着骏马嘶鸣特质的长啸由远及近！
只见一匹神骏非凡的“马”破浪而来。
它并非凡马，身躯覆盖着青铜般的光泽，线条流畅充满力量感，最奇特的是它生有八条健壮的马腿，蹄下并非踏地，而是自动分开水流，在海中奔驰如履平地。
这正是波塞冬随心所欲“创造”出的海中坐骑，他恶趣味地为其命名为“斯雷普尼尔”。
“来吧，老伙计！虽然换了个世界，但你也得跑出‘八足神驹’的风采来！”
波塞冬翻身跨上马背，三叉戟向前一指。
希律律——！
斯雷普尼尔顿时发出一声龙吟般的嘶鸣，八蹄齐动，载着波塞冬，化作一道流光，直冲战场而去。
轰隆隆隆——！！！
战场中心，波塞冬与蓬托斯的对决，无疑是整片海域中最夺目也最致命的风景。
一方，是脚跨八足神骏青铜马，周身环绕着湛蓝神光的海之新王，波塞冬。
另一方，是脚踏一只八爪深海魔兽，浑身散发着浑浊死寂幽光的原始海神，蓬托斯。
两种截然相反，代表了海洋“生”与“死”、“秩序”与“混乱”、“新生”与“陈旧”的力量，每一次碰撞，都爆发出令空间扭曲，让海底陆架崩裂的恐怖空爆！
仿佛勇者与魔王，光明与黑暗的宿命对决，在这深海之中上演。
而他们麾下的军队，风格也截然不同。
波塞冬一方的海仙女、海豚骑士、以及自愿参战的海中灵兽，阵型自由而灵动，攻守转换如行云流水，充分利用海洋环境，时而聚合如磐石，时而散开如流水，充满了生命特有的韧性。
而蓬托斯一方的军队，则诡异得令人头皮发麻。
无论是强大的海怪，还是原本美丽的宁芙仙女，此刻都如同被无形丝线操控的木偶，队列整齐划一到了一种病态的程度，进攻时一往无前，毫不畏死，脸上没有任何表情，只有眼中那摇曳的幽绿鬼火。
“为了波塞冬大人！！为了清澈的海洋！！”
蓝发的海仙女们骑着温顺而迅捷的海马，组成轻灵的骑兵队，呼啸着掠过战场，手中的水晶长矛刺向敌人。
而对面，那些被控制的宁芙们，则发出不似人声的嘶吼，肢体以违反常理的姿态扭曲着，疯狂地扑上来，用指甲、牙齿、甚至身体撞击的方式反扑。
锵！噗嗤！
即使被海马骑兵锋利的矛尖贯穿身体，那些蓬托斯的士兵也仿佛感觉不到痛楚，反而更加狂暴，甚至试图抓住长矛，将骑兵拖下马背。
content_en:
In the deep sea that has returned to silence, Poseidon stands alone.
His gaze seemed to penetrate the endless sea water and chaotic battlefield, locking on a certain direction in the distance.
There, the original sea god Pontos, with a posture similar to his, was overlooking the killing field boiling because of him.
In Poseidon's perception, Pontos' ancient and huge divine body was wrapped with a dark green light that was as thick as substance.
That dim light seemed to have life, like countless evil tentacles linking every marine creature following him on the battlefield.
And those creatures, whether they are powerful sea monsters or beautiful fairies, all have the same light that has lost self-awareness in their eyes.
To Poseidon, the appearance of Pontos was just like those depraved and corrupt evil gods in some fantasy works of previous lives, who took pleasure in controlling souls!
"It's true... after becoming a god, my life is much more exciting than in my previous life."
Poseidon didn't know whether he sighed or murmured self-deprecatingly.
Immediately, his eyes flashed, and all laziness and casualness instantly subsided.
He condensed the Poseidon Trident with his backhand and whistled softly at the same time.
Herod——!
A roar as loud and clear as a dragon's roar, with the characteristics of a horse's neighing, coming from far and near!
I saw an extraordinary "horse" coming through the waves.
It is no ordinary horse. Its body is covered with bronze-like luster, and its lines are smooth and full of power. The most peculiar thing is that it has eight strong horse legs. Instead of stepping on the ground, its hooves automatically separate the water flow, and it gallops in the sea as if it were walking on flat ground.
This is the sea mount that Poseidon "created" at his whim, and he named it "Sleipnir" in a playful way.
"Come on, old man! Even though it's a different world, you still have to show off your 'eight-legged horse' style!"
Poseidon turned over and mounted his horse, pointing his trident forward.
Herod——!
Sleipnir suddenly let out a roar like a dragon's roar, moved his eight hooves in unison, carried Poseidon, turned into a stream of light, and rushed straight to the battlefield.
...
Rumble, rumble—! ! !
In the center of the battlefield, the duel between Poseidon and Pontos is undoubtedly the most eye-catching and deadly scenery in the entire sea.
On one side is the new king of the sea, Poseidon, who sits on an eight-legged bronze horse and is surrounded by azure divine light.
On the other side, there was the original sea god, Pontos, who was riding an eight-clawed deep-sea monster and exuding a turbid, deathly light.
Two completely opposite forces, representing the "life" and "death", "order" and "chaos", "new life" and "obsolescence" of the ocean. Every collision erupts into a terrifying air explosion that distorts space and collapses the submarine shelf!
It seems that the fateful showdown between the brave and the devil, between light and darkness, is taking place in this deep sea.
The styles of the armies under their command are also completely different.
The sea nymphs on Poseidon's side, the dolphin knights, and the sea spirit beasts who volunteered to participate in the battle formed free and flexible formations. They switched offense and defense like flowing clouds and flowing water. They made full use of the ocean environment, sometimes gathering like rocks, sometimes spreading out like flowing water, and full of the unique resilience of life.
The army on Pontos' side was so weird that it made people feel numb.
Whether it was the powerful sea monster or the originally beautiful nymph, they were like puppets controlled by invisible threads at this moment. Their formations were uniform to a morbid level. When attacking, they moved forward without fear of death. There was no expression on their faces, only the swaying green will-o'-the-wisp in their eyes.
"For Lord Poseidon!! For the clear ocean!!"
The blue-haired sea nymphs rode docile and swift seahorses to form an agile cavalry team, roaring across the battlefield, stabbing the enemy with the crystal spears in their hands.
On the opposite side, the controlled nymphs let out roars that were not like human voices, twisted their limbs in unnatural postures, and rushed forward crazily, fighting back with nails, teeth, and even body collisions.
Clang! Poof!
Even though the sharp spear points of the seahorse cavalry penetrated their bodies, the Pontos soldiers seemed not to feel the pain. Instead, they became more violent and even tried to grab the spears and drag the cavalry off their horses.
